name: Color Blind Picker / Graphite
reference: Original WPF floating picker; design only, no Rust implementation.

window.rule: Allow text wrapping and increased window width with text scaling. Drag from titlebar; controls exclude drag region.

close.rule: Keep the close icon red in all window variants; preserve the accessible name and keyboard focus ring.

readout.rule: Describe the color in text. Keep UI surfaces neutral; never use the sampled color as a UI accent.

button.rule: Expose names to assistive technology; essential actions have visible labels.

pin.rule: Use both a filled neutral background and programmatic pressed state; show tooltip on focus and hover.

history.rule: Each row pairs a swatch with a name and HEX value. Show copy and more actions. Put delete behind more actions; offer undo.

settings.rule: Local panel; preserve access to the current color. English strings are pending, preview is Italian.

feedback.rule: Icon and plain text; announce results on explicit user action. Do not announce live color sampling on every cursor movement.

interaction.live: Read color under cursor continuously. UI preview uses fixed demo samples.
interaction.capture: Enter screen capture mode; select a point, save the color, copy the configured value, then return to live mode.
interaction.cancelCapture: Escape returns to live mode without saving.
interaction.copy: Copy displayed color using selected HEX or RGB format.
interaction.keyboard: Native focus order, Enter/Space activate focused controls, Escape dismisses menus or cancels capture.
interaction.shortcuts: Global shortcuts are not assigned in this proposal.
interaction.motion: Respect reduced motion; no flashing or looping live indicators.

accessibility.scaling: Validate 200% text scale in the eventual native implementation.
accessibility.status: Measured neutral text pairs only; no full accessibility conformance claim.

figma.delivery: SVG contains editable vector and text layers. Import does not create native variables, auto layout, or component sets. These require a connected Figma authoring capability.
